annotations.title: Inputs, price and example of one tool

description: Everything needed to call one tool: what it does, every input with its type, whether it is required and an example value, the price per successful call (and the lower price with a prepaid key where there is one), whether it is in the free calls, an example call and the shape of its answer. Free. Take the name from find_tool.
